subject: Re: rhget and rhwrite errors in map function

messages.author: a5ca085497920157
messages.subject: Re: rhget and rhwrite errors in map function
parts:
rhget is in the library package for Rhipe which is not loaded inside of the MapReduce environment unless you do so as you would for any R code.  See the setup argument of rhmr and use library(Rhipe).

Also, because rhget depends on a back-end rhipe java process I am not entirely sure that it is a solid scaling idea to do it that way in the Map.  You can do it.  It would probably work to a certain degree, but you may want to consider this closely.



On Tuesday, September 25, 2012 10:32:53 AM UTC-4, Raj Patrao wrote:

Hello,

 

I am new to RHIPE – trying to run a simple distributed job where each node processes a *.tar file.  Tar files are uploaded into hdfs using shell script, and a file containing list of shell scripts “inputfilelist” is also created and uploaded into hdfs.

 

I am getting error when trying to rhget and untar the file.

 

Here is the script :

 

library(Rhipe)

rhinit()

 

# list of tar files – created and uploaded into HDFS before starting R

# using shell script

inputfilelist <- "/user/hduser/AZD2input/inputfilelist"

 

map <- expression({

  lapply(seq_along(map.values),function(r){

 

       v <- map.values[[r]]     

 

       rhget(v, ".")

       untar(v)

 

        rhcollect(map.keys[[r]],c(map.values[[r]]))

  })

})

## Create a job object

z <- rhmr(map, ifolder=inputfilelist, ofolder="/user/hduser/AZD2Onput",

       inout=c('text','sequence'),

       mapred=list(mapred.reduce.tasks=0),

       jobname='test')

## Submit the job

rhex(z,async=FALSE)
